data.name: Let it ride!
data.detailed_description:
SkiFree meets Bullet Hell.

Remember that old skiing game where a yeti inevitably ate you? Now imagine you have a machine gun (well, a rapid-fire snowball thrower) and the yeti brought 9 types of friends.

Let it ride! is a fast-paced action where the only way is down. You are a skier on a mission: survive the avalanche of monsters, collect upgrades, and keep your momentum. It’s not just about shooting; it’s about flow. Weave through trees, react to the terrain, and turn the mountainside into a graveyard of snow-goons.

❄️ Winter is Coming (Whenever You Want)

Miss the snow? Hate the heat? Or maybe you just love the smell of pine trees and gunpowder in the morning. We’ve packed the game with shredding rock covers of classic Christmas carols. It’s festive, it’s loud, and it’s the perfect soundtrack for pixelated violence. Launch the game in July and cool off instantly.* (Cooling effect not included in a package!).

⛷️ Key Features

  • The "Survivors" on Skis: Classic horde-survival gameplay, but with gravity on your side. Keep moving, keep shooting, and don't hug the trees. Except for that achievement...

  • Physics-Based Mayhem: It’s not just about aiming. You need to steer! Dodge obstacles, jump over enemies, and use your momentum to drift into power-ups.

  • Squirrels Beware: Look, we love nature. But if a squirrel stands between you and a high score... CRUSH IT. (We are not responsible for emotional damage caused to rodent lovers).

  • Procedural Powder: Every run is a fresh mountain. The slopes, obstacles, and enemy waves are procedurally generated, so you’ll never ski the same line twice.

  • Linear Progression: Straightforward, satisfying upgrades. Turn your snowball toss into a blizzard of pain.

  • Achievements & Glory: Hunt down in-game achievements and prove you’re the king of the hill.

Grab your skis. Load your snowballs. Let it ride!

data.short_description: SkiFree meets Survivors! Shred down a procedural mountain, blasting monsters to hard-rock Christmas tunes. Dodge trees, jump enemies, and yes—you can run over squirrels. Fast-paced winter chaos for any season!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: x64 architecture
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX11, DX12 capable
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • VR Support: It's 1990! VR doesn't exist yet! Don't create a time paradox!
